_note: Tim's steering for the island (W1.4). tools/seed_world.mjs applies these to the blueprint, then re-derives corridors, lanes and stats. paint: [{ code, x0, z0, x1, z1 } or { code, x, z, r }]; remove: [id]; move: [{ id, x, z }]; add: { sites|nodes|camps: [records] }; set: [{ id, fields }]. Each entry may carry a _why. coastCliff: { depth, harborOpen, riverOpen, openAreas: [{ x0, z0, x1, z1 }] } turns land near the open sea into cliff cells. paint may also use near: { biome, cells } and only: '<codes>'.
